cohort: The study retrospectively analyzed postpartum placentas from 35 cases with fetal distress, 40 cases with premature rupture of membranes, and 30 cases with normal delivery.
finding: Increased placental cell apoptosis, characterized by elevated expression of apoptosis-related genes CDKN1A, BAX, and HSP-70, is associated with the pathological changes seen in fetal distress and premature rupture of membranes.
